slides.headline: SAM ALTMAN JUST PULLED OPENAI'S IPO
slides.body: Sam Altman said OpenAI won't list on any stock market this year, and he gave one reason: AI safety. "Right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," he said. The company behind ChatGPT stays private for now

slides.headline: TESLA'S ROADSTER SITE JUST WOKE UP, THE AI CAR COMPANY IS BACK
slides.body: Tesla, the company using real-world AI to train the world's largest self-driving fleet, updated the Roadster's website for the first time in nearly 9 years. A countdown hits zero on October 1 in Waco, Texas, and reservation holders already have their invites.

slides.headline: ANTHROPIC JUST PICKED ITS STOCK MARKET
slides.body: Claude's maker chose Nasdaq for its upcoming IPO. Same day Altman said OpenAI is sitting out, Anthropic is doing the exact opposite, and now the two biggest AI rivals have completely different plans for your money

slides.headline: INDIA JUST LAUNCHED ITS FIRST-EVER EYE IN THE SKY
slides.body: India's space agency (ISRO) put a satellite into orbit that hovers over the same patch of Earth and never moves. Most satellites loop overhead and disappear, this one parks over the same spot and never leaves, giving India continuous imaging coverage for the first time.

slides.headline: ALL FOUR BIG AI COMPANIES JUST CALLED FOR A SLOWDOWN
slides.body: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Meta AI all came out the same day asking the industry to slow down. The companies building the most powerful AI in the world are now saying out loud they're worried, and that has never happened before

Sam Altman says OpenAI won't go public this year, citing AI safety. Tesla's Roadster website came back to life after 9 years with a countdown to an October 1 reveal in Waco, Texas. Anthropic picked Nasdaq for its IPO. India launched its first imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit. All four frontier AI labs publicly called for a slowdown on the same day.

In one day: OpenAI paused its IPO, Anthropic picked a stock exchange, and all four major AI labs said the industry is moving too fast. The people building the most powerful AI are nervous, and the money keeps flowing. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

pinned_comment: Sam Altman says AI safety is the reason OpenAI won't go public, but Anthropic picked its stock exchange the same day. Do the biggest AI labs actually want to slow down, or is this something they say to buy themselves time?
